prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness radiating into the left buttock. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from history or records reviewed. Over the course of 24 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and progressive strengthening, with frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which support the clinical impression. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and straight-leg raise, was within normal limits. Billing entries for two similar services on the same date are currently under administrative review and are being verified against the treatment record. Patient is discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
